title: Claude launcher attach paths re-parse the command with the Unknown dialect, so a quoted-pipe launcher line gets a launch row but never an artifact
outcome: For a Claude Bash launcher line, the locator association (cut and uncut output) and the background-end registration route recognise the command with the same Bash runtime dialect that created its launch row, so a direct launcher line with a quoted `|` (e.g. `-- --skip 'alpha|beta'`) has its run attached and settled like any other.
acceptance: For Claude provenance, observe_test_command_artifact_from and claude_ordinary_launcher recognise the line with runtime Bash (as engram_plain_check_command_in does at start), so a direct focused launcher line whose test arguments contain a quoted `|` attaches its run from a visible RUN locator and, at a background end, from its sole matching registration; shown by behaviour tests for both routes. Other providers' recognition is unchanged.
